$comment: T10 R8 performance baseline. Measured by www/e2e/performance-budget.spec.ts (mobile 4G profile: 4 Mbps/3 Mbps/150 ms RTT, CPU 4x throttle, 390x844 DPR2, cold cache per run, median of N). Fields at 0 are NOT measured by the harness yet and are skipped by the comparison; the first in-harness run in a browser window re-baselines them. Absolute values are one machine's; the comparison band (+35%) is deliberately loose because shared CI runners are noisy.
note: Seeded from the T10 phase-1 audit baseline (2026-10-18, lane/t10-audit, da7d8905e) using .zcode/scratch/t10/web-vitals-baseline.mjs (N=3 medians). INP was 0 there because that script drove no interactions; transferBytes was only readable for / (content-length missing on other responses) — this harness measures both properly, so the first verification run replaces those zeros.
